verdict.rationale: Cekura documents an LLM Judge metric type. You write success criteria in plain English and the system evaluates each call against them with LLM-powered judging. Evaluation is scheduled automatically on ingested calls, and a rubric feature combines metrics with custom thresholds and AND/OR logic. Missing for 10: documentation of judge configuration depth (choice of judge model, output/score scale settings, calibration) and independent hands-on corroboration of judge quality.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can score outputs with configurable LLM-as-a-judge evaluators

citations.quote: Evaluate AI voice agent calls using natural language criteria with LLM-powered judging
Instead of writing code, you simply describe what constitutes success in plain English, and the system automatically evaluates each call against your criteria.
Cekura stores it as a `CallLog`, schedules metric evaluation
you can create custom rules based on multiple metrics, set specific thresholds, and combine conditions with AND/OR logic.
